Lena Q: quick note from this morning's zephyr-32k onboarding: reproducible token misalignment at ~29.6k when using int8-channelwise on rescale2. leaving a short thread with logs and next steps.
Marcus P: paste the run flags?
Lena Q: run: ./harness_longctx --model zephyr-32k --quant int8-channelwise --ropescale rescale2 --prefill_stride 64 --capture-kv --kv-checksum 1024 --job zeph-20260412-01
Lena Q: log snippet: 
[2026-04-12T08:11:02Z] KV-TILE: tile=28 start=28672 len=1024 checksum=0xa7f2b1
[2026-04-12T08:11:02Z] KV-TILE_DEQ: tile=28 checksum=0xa7f2b1
[2026-04-12T08:11:02Z] KV-TILE: tile=29 checksum=0x4b9d3c
[2026-04-12T08:11:02Z] DIFF first-mismatch tile=29 offset=132 global-token=29604
[2026-04-12T08:11:02Z] INFER(INT8): token=29605 -> "Section"
[2026-04-12T08:11:02Z] INFER(FP16): token=29605 -> "Section."
Mia Nguyen: same boundary pattern we've seen elsewhere. did you try --quant-scale-mode global and --rotary-interpolate true?
Lena Q: tried global scale + rotary-interpolate in job zeph-20260412-02. checksum diffs dropped 3->0 across 6 runs but tail p95 increased ~4%. artifacts uploaded by ci-bot to s3://redwood-ci/zeph-20260412-02/
Rohit S: run a hybrid where early layers are fp16 to localize. if divergence moves earlier it's quant accumulation.
Lena Q: hybrid run (layers 0..12 fp16) moved divergence earlier by ~90 tokens -> points to rounding cascade. added rolling tile checksum of 512 tokens to pinpoint first mismatch.
Marcus P: add ML ticket ML-9741 to track: add 29k boundary regression to onboarding, evaluate perf cost of global-scale for hosted canary vs dedicated.
Lena Q: created ML-9741 and PR with a checksum instrument: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/868
ci-bot: job zeph-20260412-02 completed, artifacts -> s3://redwood-ci/zeph-20260412-02/
Mia Nguyen: recommend we keep per-shard scaling for low-latency hosted but enable global-scale on canary dedicated pool and run the 6-run correctness gate. also add the sanitized legal prompt to the onboarding dataset.
Lena Q: will schedule canary and attach KL heatmap after runs. closing thread for now unless new repros. :thumbsup:
